units.source_text: 有一天傍晚，又派那个惟光送信去。

en.t: One evening, he again sent Koremitsu to deliver a letter.

units.source_text: 信中说：“今夜我本当亲自前来探望，因有要事，未能如愿。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, Tonight I had meant to come in person to ask after you, but important business has kept me from doing as I wished.

units.source_text: 你们将怪我疏远么？”

en.t: Will you think me neglectful and distant?

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母对惟光说：“兵部卿大人突然派人来言：明天就要迎接姑娘到那边去。

en.t: The nurse Shonagon said to Koremitsu, Lord Hyobukyo has suddenly sent word that tomorrow he will take the young lady over to his house.

units.source_text: 因此我心中乱得很。

en.t: Because of that, my heart is in great turmoil.

units.source_text: 这长年住惯的破屋，一朝要离去，到底也有点不忍。

en.t: This poor house, where we have lived for so many years, is hard to leave all at once after all.

units.source_text: 众侍女也都心慌意乱了。”

en.t: All the serving women are flustered and beside themselves too.

units.source_text: 她草草地应对，并没有好好地招待他。

en.t: She received him hurriedly and did not properly entertain him.

units.source_text: 惟光看见她们手忙脚乱地缝衣服，整理物件，觉得也不便久留，便匆匆回去报命。

en.t: Seeing them busily sewing clothes and putting belongings in order, Koremitsu felt it would be awkward to stay long, so he hurried back to report.

units.source_text: 此时源氏公子正住在左大臣家。

en.t: At this time Prince Genji was staying at the Minister of the Left's residence.

units.source_text: 葵姬并不立刻出来相见。

en.t: Lady Aoi did not come out at once to see him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中不快，姑且弹弹和琴，吟唱“我在常陆勤耕田……”的风俗歌[\[28\]](#part1334.html#m28)。

en.t: Feeling displeased, Prince Genji idly played the wagon and sang the folk song, I diligently till the fields in Hitachi....

units.source_text: 歌声优美而飘荡。

en.t: His singing voice was beautiful and drifted through the air.

units.source_text: 正在这时候惟光来了。

en.t: Just then Koremitsu arrived.

units.source_text: 他便唤他走近，探问那边情况。

en.t: Genji called him close and asked about the situation there.

units.source_text: 惟光回话“如此如此”，源氏公子心中着急。

en.t: When Koremitsu reported that matters were thus and so, Prince Genji grew anxious.

units.source_text: 他想：“迁居兵部卿家之后，我倘特地前去求婚，并且要迎接她来此，这行径未免太轻薄了。

en.t: He thought, If after she moves to Lord Hyobukyo's house I deliberately go there to ask for her hand and bring her here, my conduct will seem far too frivolous.

units.source_text: 倘不告诉他，擅自把她迎接来此，也不过受到一个盗取小孩的恶评罢了。

en.t: If I do not tell him and bring her here on my own, I will merely earn the bad name of having stolen a child.

units.source_text: 好，我就在她迁居以前暂时教乳母等保密，把她迎接到这里来吧！”

en.t: Very well, before she moves, I will have the nurse and the others keep it secret for the time being and bring her here.

units.source_text: 便吩咐惟光：“天亮以前，我要到那边去。

en.t: Then he instructed Koremitsu, Before daybreak, I will go there.

units.source_text: 车子的装备就照我到这里来时一样，随身带一两人够了。”

en.t: Prepare the carriage just as it was when I came here; one or two attendants with me will be enough.

units.source_text: 惟光奉命而去。

en.t: Koremitsu received the order and went off.
